A '''skirmish''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives and an unit of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] soldiers. This failed Imperial attempt to capture the Rebels resulted in high Imperial and civilian casualties.<ref name="WbC" />
